bio: Antje and Ronny Pester's charming restaurant is located in the town centre, in the wing of the town hall. In the cosy, tastefully decorated interior, they serve ambitious modern cuisine that follows the seasons – the fragrant tuna tartare, for example, is delicious. They serve a small à la carte selection Wed, Thu and Sun, and a set menu on Fri and Sat – a vegetarian version can be pre-ordered. The service is attentive and friendly, and the owner's wine suggestions are spot on. Lovely terrace to the rear of the building....
